intro: A trainer stands perfectly still in the path. Her clothes are ordinary. Her Pokéballs shimmer like the air above hot asphalt.
speaker: Emissary Delta
introDialogue: You've seen the tears by now. You've seen what lives on the other side.$Where I come from, your Pokémon took different paths. Better ones, some would say.$I can show you. One of yours — remade as it exists on my side of the seam.$But proof of worth first. My team was all converted long ago. Beat them, and we'll talk.
title: The Delta Emissary
description: A trainer from beyond the rift offers a duel. Her team is entirely @[TOOLTIP_TITLE]{Delta Pokémon} — and if you win, she will convert one of yours to the delta form it maps to. The mapping is fixed: every species has exactly one delta destiny.
converted: {{pokemonName}} was remade! It is now a Delta Pokémon!

1.label: Accept the Duel
1.tooltip: (?) Battle her delta team. Victory: convert one party member to its delta form
1.selected: She nods once and the air around her Pokéballs bends.

2.label: Decline
2.selected: "Another time, then. The seams aren't going anywhere. Neither are we."

outro: She walks toward nothing in particular and is gone before she gets there.
